checks.rule: FPV eye follows the original seated position on every kart orientation

input.script: Four yaw/pitch/bank poses, including translated elevated poses; compare camera with the actual model transform.

checks.expected: Eye position agrees with the model-transformed original (0,1.32,-0.78) offset to within 1e-9 m; FOV=76 and near=0.04.

checks.rule: FPV faces down the road and is clear of the kart at neutral look

input.script: Use the original kart on flat ground at four headings; raycast the FPV center line and project the steering wheel.

checks.expected: Camera faces the kart nose with the original slight downward angle; the kart does not obstruct the center view and the steering-wheel center is inside the frame.

checks.rule: FPV look is frame-independent and stays inside comfortable limits

input.script: Integrate the same one-second head-look input at each rate, then apply a large drag.

checks.expected: Final view direction matches across rates; yaw stays within 1.2 rad and pitch within 0.45 rad.

checks.rule: View changes and repeated FPV selection reset head look without altering the kart

input.script: Toggle FPV/back ten times with head look; compare authoritative physics, pose and clock before/after.

checks.expected: No kart state/clock changes; FPV reselect centers head look; original camera near plane is restored on exit.

checks.rule: FPV observes the same interpolated drive without changing any driving settings

input.script: Run one second of the existing driving test with FPV update after every display frame; compare to identical run with no camera.

checks.expected: Every authoritative state value is identical; normal top speed remains 120 mph and boost 180 mph.
